verdict.rationale: Svelte documents relevant building-block capabilities of its own: a compiler that emits lean, surgically updating JavaScript, component-scoped CSS, TypeScript support, shared reactive logic in .svelte.ts modules, `sv check` for static errors, and SvelteKit build optimizations and per-page rendering choices. One team reports migrating a huge, complex React app with large gains in performance and productivity, and another reports a snappy, debuggable large app. However, no first-party material addresses scaling to large teams and codebases. Community reports note the smaller ecosystem and component-library gaps limiting use to smaller projects, plus DOM rendering limits at high element counts. Missing for 10: first-party guidance or evidence on large-codebase and team-scale architecture, broader independent corroboration of performance at scale, and a mature ecosystem for big apps.
